name: cartoon
description: Token-optimized CLI output: wrap test runs and JSON CLIs in `cartoon` (~70% fewer input tokens on verbose test runs; an estimate). Includes a PreToolUse hook that rewrites noisy dev-loop commands (pytest, jest, cargo test, go test, make, npm test, pre-commit, ...) to run under cartoon and AUTO-APPROVES the rewritten command (permissionDecision: allow), so those commands skip your permission prompt. Prefer a prompt? Skip this plugin: add the skill with `npx skills add abhijitbansal/cartoon` and run `cartoon hook install --deny` (deny-and-suggest: nothing is auto-approved). Requires the cartoon binary; the hook is a no-op without it.
